capabilities.claim: Parsed structural byte ranges can be read back directly from source.
physical_evidence: skills-shared#256 live parse and 21 byte-range readbacks

capabilities.claim: Semantic retrieval may produce candidates that require exact path and source readback.
physical_evidence: skills-shared#256 live argv/source readback and nonsense-query nearest neighbours

ed3c/noodles#7 pinned grepai 0.30.0 argv against an out-of-tree index: 5 candidates read back from candidate source, nonsense control outscored the real query (0.531 > 0.402), zero candidate-tree residue
non_claims: A miss is not absence proof and a hit is not source truth.

capabilities.claim: Read-only symbol navigation resolves find_symbol to find_referencing_symbols to direct source readback at a pinned Serena version against an exact repository commit, reports wrong, ambiguous, unsupported-language, and stale-index queries as bounded outcomes, and leaves no source diff or index residue.
physical_evidence: ed3c/noodles#8 fresh read-only navigation receipt at serena-agent 1.7.0
non_claims: No bounded edit, test execution, receipt lifecycle, or edit authority is admitted.
An index hit is not source truth: the stale-index control shows the reported location must still be read back from source.
No Serena executor is migrated by name and no enabled provider checkout is added.

capabilities.claim: A provider endpoint was reachable but no target repository binding was proven.

capabilities.claim: A fresh exact-commit indexing and lookup receipt now exists; promoting the disposition is a separate evidence-admission decision, not a consequence of the receipt existing.
non_claims: SCIP was absent from the historical physical run.
The receipt covers Python-only lookup at one exact commit and grants no capability status by itself.
No migration-by-name, complete language coverage, edit authority, or required dependency of code-intelligence v1.

capabilities.claim: The same-task A/B ran and LanceDB lost it: on one corpus, one embedder, and one top-5 budget it reached the target file for 12 of 17 tasks against the landed path's 16, and spent 55% more context doing it.
physical_evidence: ed3c/noodles#11 pinned lancedb 0.37.1 on one corpus and one embedder: recall@5 0.706 against the landed arm's 0.941, and a ranking byte-identical to the same vectors scored with no store at all
non_claims: Architecture diagrams do not prove that a vector store is needed.
DROP records a measured loss on this repository at this budget; it is not a proof that no vector store can help a larger corpus.
The store-free control arm, not the A/B gap, is what attributes the result to LanceDB: the B arm's chunker differs from grepai's, so the gap alone would have measured the chunker.

capabilities.claim: No platform admission evidence exists in the historical receipt.
non_claims: No stacked-PR dependency is added to the Golden Path.

capabilities.claim: A bounded edit lifecycle ran physically at pinned Serena 1.7.0 against an exact repository commit: find_symbol to find_referencing_symbols to one allowlisted symbol-body edit to immutable tests to diff and source readback to cleanup, admitted only when the produced diff stayed inside the declared path scope, the navigated body still matched source at edit time, every reference site still read back, and the immutable tests stayed unchanged and green.
non_claims: Promoting the disposition is a separate evidence-admission decision, not a consequence of the receipt existing.
The boundary is the external diff gate, not the tool: the allowlisted symbol editor edited an out-of-scope file without complaint and only the scope guard stopped the run.
No generic executor, autonomous refactor authority, or multi-file semantic correctness is admitted.
No production admission beyond this tested atom and no enabled provider checkout is added.

capabilities.claim: Individual adapter observations did not prove a causal production pipeline.
physical_evidence: skills-shared#368 explicitly denies end-to-end chain proof
non_claims: No GrepAI→SCIP→SQLite→Tree-sitter→Serena chain is migrated as a unit.
